name: Garry's Mod
description: Garry's Mod dedicated server (Steam app 4020, native Linux 32-bit srcds, anonymous login). Port 27015 carries the game (UDP) and RCON (TCP) and is mirrored. Workshop: GMod does not use the panel's Workshop tab; instead set 'Workshop collection ID' and the server downloads the whole collection itself (+host_workshop_collection) and makes clients download it too. Individual .gma addons dropped into garrysmod/addons with the Files tab also work but clients will not auto-download them without a Lua resource.AddWorkshop line. Counter-Strike: Source content (for textures of many maps) is not installed. A GSLT is recommended. Server data in garrysmod/ is not part of the default backups; include game files when you back up.

variables.label: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser (hostname convar).

variables.label: Server password
variables.description: Password players need to join (sv_password). Leave empty for a public server.

variables.label: RCON password
variables.description: Remote console password (rcon_password), also needed by external admin tools. Leave empty to have one generated when the server is created (20 characters); managers can read and regenerate it in Settings.

variables.label: Game Server Login Token (GSLT)
variables.description: Steam game server login token, 32 hexadecimal characters, created at https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers for app 4000. Optional but strongly recommended: without it the server may run as an anonymous, unlisted or restricted server.

variables.label: Starting map
variables.description: Map the server starts on (for example gm_construct, gm_flatgrass). The map must exist on the server.

variables.label: Gamemode
variables.description: Gamemode folder name, for example sandbox, terrortown, darkrp, prop_hunt. Non-default gamemodes must be installed (usually through a Workshop collection).

variables.label: Tick rate
variables.description: Server tick rate (-tickrate). 22 saves CPU, 66 is the usual value.

variables.label: Workshop collection ID
variables.description: Numeric id of a Steam Workshop collection to load (+host_workshop_collection). Leave empty for none.

ready.logRegex: Connection to Steam servers successful|gameserver Steam ID
